pos_pick_hint: Search a medicine, then add it to the cart
pos_cart_hint: Cart is empty. Search a medicine, then press Add.
must_change_password: Please set a new password before continuing.
password_too_short: Password must be at least 6 characters.
name: Name
shortcuts: F2 search  •  F8 hold  •  F9 pay  •  Del remove line  •  Esc clear
restore_confirm: Restore will replace all current data. Continue?
no_open_sale: Finish or clear the current sale before restoring.
cart_open_close: There are items in the cart. Close anyway?
purchase_need_supplier: Pick or type the company you bought from.
purchase_need_medicine: Select a medicine from the list.
purchase_need_line: Add at least one medicine line before saving.
secondary_backup_hint: Choose a USB drive, Documents folder, or OneDrive / Google Drive folder. Every backup is saved here as well as on this PC.
backup_warning: WARNING — backup is stale, missing, or the USB is not available
delete_sale_detail:
The sale is removed from sales history, the home page, reports and the customer's udhaar.
Tablets that were not already returned go back into stock.
recover_hint: If you used this software before, pick a backup file. Otherwise skip.
setup_required: Please finish setup (pharmacy name and backup folder) before using the app.
launch_alert: {exp} medicines expire within 6 months, {low} below reorder level
low_stock_after_sale: Now at or below reorder level
period_closed: Previous month archived. The new month is open.
printer_hint: Black Copper BC-86AC: choose it above and keep 'Direct (ESC/POS)'. Each bill is sent as one job that feeds 4 lines and cuts, so the paper stops right after the bill.
printer_queue_waiting:
The printer has {n} old job(s) still waiting. These make it print again and again.

Yes = clear them and print this bill
No = keep them and print
Cancel = do not print
queue_clear_failed: Could not clear the print queue. Open Windows Settings > Printers, select the printer and cancel the jobs, or run the app as administrator once.
printer_status_warn:
Windows reports the printer as: {status}.
Print anyway?
printer_pick_hint: Select the thermal printer for bills (for example BC-86AC). This is saved in Settings.
print_failed: Bill was saved but could not be printed.
test_sent: Test slip sent. It should print a short slip and stop.
no_printers: No printer is installed in Windows.
archived_ok: '{name}' was removed from all lists. Its old bills and history are kept. To bring it back: tick 'Show deleted', Edit it and tick Active (or simply Add it again).
deleted_ok: '{name}' was deleted. A backup was taken first.
delete_confirm:
Delete '{name}'?
A backup is taken automatically before deleting.
backup_failed_continue: Backup before delete failed. Delete anyway?
cannot_disable_self: You cannot disable the account you are logged in with.
company_type_or_pick: Pick a company or type a new name
create_company_q: '{name}' is not in your company list. Add it as a new company?
delete_company_hint: If this company has medicines, purchases or payments it is only archived (hidden), never erased.
delete_medicine_hint: The medicine disappears from POS, Stock, Dashboard, Expiry and alerts. If it was never bought or sold it is erased completely. If it has old bills, those bills stay correct and the medicine is kept hidden (tick 'Show deleted' to see it).
delete_has_stock: It still has {n} units in stock. This stock is removed from stock value and all lists (written in the stock ledger).
delete_purchase_hint: Use this only for a wrong entry. The stock it added is removed. Not allowed if any of that stock was sold or returned, or a company payment is linked. For goods sent back, use Purchase return.
duplicate_customer: A customer with this name and phone already exists. Save another one anyway?
nothing_due: Nothing is due to this company.
backup_password: Owner password used for this backup:
restore_summary:
This backup contains {medicines} medicines and {sales} sales (last sale: {last}).

A backup of the current data is taken first. Replace the current data with this backup?
cart_items_removed: These items were removed from the cart because they were deleted or their stock is no longer available:
